overlapping_phenotypes: developmental delay, intellectual disability, relative macrocephaly or frontal bossing, and pulmonary valve stenosis
discriminating_logic: Classical CFC syndrome presents with near-universal (>85%) striking ectodermal involvement and a ~40% rate of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, whereas YWHAZ loss-of-function mutations exhibit non-syndromic intellectual disability without classic CFC cutaneous or cardiac findings.

overlapping_phenotypes: global neurodevelopmental delays, hypotonia, and craniofacial dysmorphism
discriminating_phenotype: classic grade 1–3 lissencephaly (complete agyria or agyria/pachygyria)
discriminating_logic: Severe neuronal migration defects (classic grade 1–3 lissencephaly) are pathognomonic hallmarks of Miller-Dieker syndrome and YWHAE haploinsufficiency, but are consistently absent in Popov-Chang syndrome.

overlapping_phenotypes: severe motor and language delay, cognitive impairment, and early-onset seizures
discriminating_logic: Severe early-infantile refractory epileptic encephalopathy with intractable tonic spasms or electrical status epilepticus in sleep is typical of SCN8A and YWHAG encephalopathies, whereas in isolated Popov-Chang syndrome, intractable epileptic encephalopathy occurs in fewer than 15% of patients.
